title: Create Requirement Traceability Matrix in Seconds with ChatGPT
application_domain: software testing (bank account opening / kiosk onboarding example)
st_activity: Generate a requirement traceability matrix that ties one requirement to the manual and automated test scenarios derived from it. ; Check whether the existing scenarios cover the requirement and report the requirement that is not covered.
llm_operation: write manual test scenarios for the requirement in version 3.5 ; verify whether the scenarios match the requirement traceability matrix ; identify the requirement that is not covered by the test scenario
llm_output: test scenarios for the requirement ; a requirement traceability matrix with per-requirement coverage indications ; a list of missing scenarios and uncovered requirements
workflow_stage: 2 Semantic contextualization ; 4 Validation and explanation ; 3 Traceability inference
verifiable_output: a requirement traceability matrix that maps the requirement to the generated manual and automated test scenarios ; per-requirement coverage indications and the requirement identified as not covered by the test scenarios
reviewer_interpretation: Practitioner tutorial. ChatGPT 3.5 drafts test scenarios from a single requirement and ChatGPT 4 checks whether those scenarios cover it, producing a requirement traceability matrix for one kiosk-onboarding example. Demonstrates LLM-assisted requirement-to-test tracing; no limitations are reported and the description is promotional.
notes: Model names are ambiguous in the spoken subtitles; recorded as NR rather than normalised.

title: Traceability and AI for Better Understanding, Communication, and QC of Trials

project_or_dataset: a demo study generated by the vendor itself (fake data, produced in house); larger phase three trials are mentioned as also supported
st_activity: Explain what the code does for a variable or data set and report whether what was specified is what is programmed. ; Generate submission documentation artefacts from the traced code, data and results. ; Derive variable-level and data-set-level traces from the statically analysed code and logs.
llm_operation: extract the clinical concepts from the question and map them to the variables and data sets that contain them ; translate code language into natural language instead of reasoning over the raw code ; compare the description against the code and report match, mismatch or unsure
llm_output: a natural-language answer with a confidence indication and the browsable evidence behind it ; the natural-language reading of the code that the answer is built on ; specification-conformance comments
model_name_in_paper: largely pre-trained models (talk also refers to ChatGPT 4 or 3.5)
workflow_stage: 3 Traceability inference ; 2 Semantic contextualization ; 4 Validation and explanation

title: Building an AI Traceability Agent for Flight Software
application_domain: aerospace flight software built on the NASA cFS flight software framework
project_or_dataset: the cFS heritage codebase; two applications in phase one; a results view listing requirements numbered in the md 2000 range
st_activity: Map each requirement to the source file and function that implement it, and to the unit test and build verification artefact that cover it. ; Keep the requirement-to-code and requirement-to-test record available per requirement and mark the mappings the agent is not certain about.
llm_operation: map the requirement to the implementing function ; decide which unit test covers the requirement and flag the cases it is not certain about
llm_output: the requirement-to-code mapping ; the requirement-to-test mapping, with uncertain mappings flagged
verifiable_output: an RTM results file per requirement listing the code file, the implementing function, the unit test file and the build verification file ; a displayed traceability record per requirement plus flags on uncertain mappings and blank cells where an artefact could not be located
